candidate_levers_ranked.name: ambiguous_below_threshold
candidate_levers_ranked.rationale: Below-threshold ambiguity carries the highest false-positive risk among the four pools because acting on it tends to drift toward threshold lowering, cue expansion, or scoring changes — all of which are explicitly out of scope for the current safety posture. Should remain last; if addressed, must be strictly aggregate-only and must not propose threshold or scoring changes.
